desc:
First code released at 500 LIKES!👍

Welcome to Wreck Racing, the realistic driving and car-destruction game!

Race, crash and smash your way to victory. Every hit dents, crumples and tears your car apart.

🏁 8 race tracks: banked ovals, figure-eights, jumps and tarmac circuits
💥 3 demolition derby arenas: last car running wins
🌄 6 free roam maps: ski jumps, mega ramps, canyons, forests and snow
🚗 7 vehicles: from muscle cars and rally coupés to a lifted 4x4 and a school bus
🔧 Deep customisation: paint, liveries, armour, bumpers, wheels and performance upgrades

👍 Like and favourite to stay up to date with new cars, maps and updates!
